extension.label: Altioo MCP iTop Extension
extension.description: Turns this iTop into a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, so an AI assistant can search, read and update CMDB and ticketing objects - never seeing or changing more than the authenticated user could through the console. Requires iTop 3.2 or 3.3 and PHP 8.2-8.4. What the caller may do is decided by iTop's own permissions, by a dedicated profile, and by the scopes of the token they authenticated with - those are the controls, and they hold whatever the assistant was told to do. Writes additionally default to a dry run that reports what would change, which is a guardrail against a confused or manipulated model acting on a plausible-looking instruction, not a permission boundary. Every call is audited. iTop itself opens no outbound connection. AGPL-3.0-or-later. See the documentation link for setup, configuration and security notes.
